title: Wheaton Precious Metals Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report
summary: Wheaton Precious Metals(tm) Corp. ("Wheaton" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the publication of its 2025 Sustainability Report . "Sustainability considerations are embedded in our decision-making process and integral to how Wheaton evaluates opportunities, manages risk, and builds resilience," said Haytham Hodaly, President Chief Executive Officer of Wheaton Precious Metals. "Our 2025 Sustainability Report reflects the results of an updated materiality assessment and includes Wheaton's progress across key performance metrics, program updates, and insights from our global portfolio of high-quality assets. From disciplined capital allocation to our support for local communities and innovation, strong sustainability practices enhance our ability to create long-term value for shareholders, mining partners, and host communities."
